pilot.timing_note: Shared host; the frozen benchmark was active during this pilot. Runs in this controller are serial.
pilot.promotion: Full KITTI 01 stereo after two passing GPU pilots with >=20% speed gains

retrieval.evidence: Saved left-image SIFT retrieval proxy and replay of saved independent constraints; no fresh geometry verification or full tracking

matching_microbenchmark.policy: Warmed matcher; transfers and synchronization included; excludes extraction and runtime initialization; shared-host timings provisional

retrieval_stereo_before_fix.evidence: Saved left-image SIFT retrieval proxy; graph replay uses saved independent loop measurements and odometry reconstructed from exported adjacent poses, not the original pre-correction snapshot
retrieval_stereo_before_fix.query_policy: Live stereo depth filtering through SharedSlam._extract
retrieval_stereo_before_fix.historical_descriptor_limit: Saved run exports omit keyframe descriptors and appended optical-flow descriptors; index bank is re-extracted SIFT from saved left images

retrieval_stereo_current.evidence: Saved left-image SIFT retrieval proxy; graph replay uses saved independent loop measurements and odometry reconstructed from exported adjacent poses, not the original pre-correction snapshot
retrieval_stereo_current.query_policy: Live detected-SIFT appearance proposal; stereo finite-depth features retained for exact matching
retrieval_stereo_current.historical_descriptor_limit: Saved descriptors are re-extracted from input images; corrected live appearance index also uses detected SIFT only, excluding appended optical-flow descriptors. This checks proposals, not fresh geometry verification

end_to_end_one_worker.policy: Parent wall time from child launch to successful exit, including interpreter/imports, estimator setup, all frames, input loading, background shutdown, exports and reference evaluation. Both runs serial, one OpenCV/BLAS worker. Shared-host background load uncontrolled; same full input files, no profiling.
